## Practice with SCP
1. Create the file `foo.txt` on your local machine, use `scp` to copy it to your CRC `home`.
1. Create the file `bar.txt` at CRC `home`, use `scp` to copy it to your local machine.
1. Create a nested directory structure locally, use `scp` to copy it to your CRC `home`.
1. Share these commands with your instructor.

## Practice with RSYNC
1. Repeat above, using `rsync`.
1. Share these commands with your instructor.
